description: DSZ - DualSense Zen: a native Windows companion for the DualSense and DualSense Edge with lighting, adaptive triggers, Bluetooth haptics, virtual controllers and per-game profiles.
notes: Virtual controllers (Xbox 360, DualSense, DualShock 4) optionally require these drivers:
- usbip-win2 0.9.8.1: https://github.com/vadimgrn/usbip-win2/releases/tag/v.0.9.8.1 (0.9.7.7 and 0.9.8.0 also work; avoid 0.9.7.8, which winget installs by default)
DSZ can also install either from its Virtual controller page.
Settings, profiles and logs are stored in %APPDATA%\DSZ.
